description_expanded: ABOUT SEASIDE SERENITY: Welcome to Seaside Serenity, the ultimate vacation home in Carillon Beach, where luxury, comfort, and coastal living come together to create your dream getaway. This 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath beach oasis is just steps from the pristine white sands and emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico, offering the perfect setting for an unforgettable vacation. Seaside Serenity features three spacious bedrooms, each thoughtfully designed to ensure comfort and privacy. The master suite serves as a tranquil retreat, complete with a plush king-sized bed, making it the perfect place to unwind after a day in the sun. The real highlight of this Gulf Coast rental is the expansive balcony lounging area. Here, you can soak in breathtaking views of Carillon Beach and the surrounding area. Whether you're hosting a dinner party or enjoying a quiet evening alone, the outdoor dining area is perfect for savoring meals and watching stunning sunsets. Located in the heart of Carillon Beach, this luxury vacation home offers easy access to the community's private beach boardwalk, multiple pools, and nearby shopping, dining, and entertainment options. Known for its charming atmosphere and friendly community, Carillon Beach is the ideal destination for your next vacation. Experience the best of the Emerald Coast at Seaside Serenity, where every detail is designed to provide you with a truly memorable stay. ABOUT THE AREA: Carillon Beach Resort on the Emerald Coast is the perfect destination for a relaxing and adventurous getaway. Start your stay with a stroll down Carillon Market Street, where you can explore charming shops, savor local cuisine at various eateries, and admire art in galleries. The resort also offers a pristine one-mile stretch of private beach with seven exclusive access points, providing a serene and uncrowded beach experience. For those seeking outdoor activities, the resort has something for everyone. Enjoy walks through scenic parks, swim in one of the resort's pools, play tennis, or engage in more adventurous pursuits like kayaking, snorkeling, and fishing. Guests can also rent bikes, stand-up paddleboards, or kayaks to explore the beautiful surroundings. Wellness is a priority at Carillon Beach Resort, with offerings like rejuvenating yoga classes at Yoga Elements and luxurious tropical treatments at Salon Baliage & Spa. Dining options at the resort cater to all tastes, from casual meals at Our Little Beach Cafe to gourmet experiences at Gratify. The Shipwreck General Store provides a convenient spot for shopping, whether you're looking for essentials or unique souvenirs. Families will find plenty to keep the kids entertained, including basketball and tennis courts, a playground, and easy beach access. Additionally, the resort offers a gym with flexible rates For a spiritual touch, the on-site chapel offers Sunday services, adding to the resort's tranquil atmosphere. Whether you're here for the beach, the activities, or simply to unwind, Carillon Beach Resort delivers a perfect blend of relaxation, recreation, and luxury. This is the ultimate destination for those looking to experience the best of the Emerald Coast. BEACH ACCESS: * Private beach access. Directly beside the house. PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Multiple community pools * Incredible gulf views * Private beach * 2 chairs and 1 umbrella PARKING: * Paid Parking available for up to 2 registered vehicles ($35/vehicle) PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * Must Be 25 years or older * No pets allowed ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests. *Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to the properties we manage may go under construction without being notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
Outdoor Features: Beach Chair Service | 2 Chairs & 1 Umbrella | Mar 1 - Oct 31
